summary.text: In Apollodorus' Epitome, the son whom Penelope bore to Odysseus on Ithaca while he was absent reigning in Thesprotia — a child Homer never names beside Telemachus.

story.text: Apollodorus says that when Odysseus, after Callidice's death, handed the Thesprotian kingdom to Polypoetes and returned to Ithaca, he found Poliporthes, whom Penelope had borne to him in his absence.
